adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group#findMembers` the request `offset` is clamped with `Math.min(this.get("user_count"), this.get("offset"))`. After `removeMember` calls `self.findMembers()` (without updating `user_count` first), the model’s `user_count` can be stale. If you remove the only user on the last page (e.g., `user_count=51, limit=50, offset=50` -> actual total becomes 50), the clamp still sends `offset=50`, so `/members.json` returns an empty `members` array and the UI shows a blank page instead of paging back. This behavior is directly implied by the new pagination/removal logic in the diff.
